r7-blast-radius.title: C2 Blast-radius honesty (CRITICAL): live sim path does NOT route through car_prior
r7-blast-radius.imperative: Trace fit_batch -> fit_driver -> session_fit.fit_session_full -> LateralEnvelopeFit (m/s2, never car_prior); sim_evaluator.evaluate_session calls fit_session_full then PhysicsSimulator.simulate_lap. Confirm live path bypasses car_prior + g-unit EstimateStore.
r7-blast-radius.finding: CRITICAL claim INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED from source. fit_batch.run_batch (fit_batch.py:36-76) imports only fit_driver+FitStore (L14-15), calls fit_driver->store.upsert; no car_prior/EstimateStore. session_fit fit_driver(L163,239) & fit_session_full(L296,401) build params via ParameterEstimator(cfg).estimate_parameters; session_fit imports NO car_prior/EstimateStore. parameter_estimator imports LateralEnvelopeFit (L23), self.lateral_fit=LateralEnvelopeFit (L45), fit_envelope (L285) = convention A m/s2; no car_prior/EstimateStore. sim_evaluator.evaluate_session (L169) imports fit_session_full+PhysicsSimulator (L194,196), calls fit_session_full (L218) then simulate_lap(track_df, full.params) (L243); the only FitStore import is in the __main__ CLI block (L302), NOT the evaluate path. car_prior/build_car_ceiling consumers confined to utilization/ + layer2/ (grep: characterize, regime_utilization, pool_driver, estimate_batch, decoupled_braking_input) — never fit_batch/session_fit/sim_evaluator/physics_simulator. Live sim path provably bypasses car_prior + g-unit store. A-vs-B blast radius claim is TRUE.

r8-rho-call.title: C3 rho call soundness: rho absent from lateral fit, unify is symbolic identity
r8-rho-call.imperative: Confirm lateral_view.py uses mu_obs=|a_lat|/(g*cos theta) with no rho in the fit; therefore adding/removing rho is representation not refit.
r8-rho-call.finding: rho call SOUND. lateral_view.py fit is rho-free: mu_obs flat = |a_lat|/(g*cos theta) (L141), banked inverse (L139) — no rho term; design matrix = [1, v^2] (L143); grip_coef=A0+A2*v^2 (L66-68) and a_lat_max=grip*g (L70-72) carry no rho. rho enters ONLY at the consumer (physics_data_models.py:245 aero=A2*rho*speed^2) and is exactly cancelled at car_prior:484,496 (A2_param=A2_g*G/air_density => A2_param*rho == A2_g*G, exact since same air_density flows downstream per car_prior:455-457). Therefore unifying rho is a symbolic identity/representation change, NOT a refit (no lstsq/bootstrap re-run). Dispositions OT-2 + Recommendation-2 'pure representation, no refit' verdict holds. Correct contrast noted: drag fit DOES bake rho (design air_density*v^2) but #525 does not propose changing it.
